$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete.

repository.description: owner/repo of this repository. Lets `uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref` resolve locally.

rules.description: Severity per rule, keyed by code (WFC401) or name (empty-binding-for-matrix-combo).

nestingDepth.description: Maximum workflows in one call chain, counting the top-level workflow (WFC602).

maxInputs.description: Inputs on one workflow_call interface before WFC605 suggests grouping them.

ignore.description: Repo-relative path prefixes or globs (`*`, `**`) whose findings are suppressed.

overrides.description: Accepted findings, each with a reason and an optional expiry date.

rule.description: Rule code (WFC104) or name (unused-input) to suppress.

target.description: Symbol the finding is about, e.g. `.github/workflows/ci.yml#inputs.legacy`. Supports `*` and `**`.

file.description: Repo-relative file path, prefix or glob the finding is located in.

reason.description: Why this finding is accepted. Required, at least 10 characters.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). After the end of this day the finding is reported again, together with WFC901.

matrixShapes.description: Declared keys of runtime-computed matrices, keyed by `<workflow path>#<job id>`. Lets wfc verify `matrix.*` reads (WFC404) instead of reporting WFC403.

plugins.description: Repo-relative JavaScript modules (.js/.mjs) exporting extra rules (default export: rule or array of rules).
